description: This file contains a script to perform a database migration or update, specifically renaming fields in the 'Project' doctype within an ERPNext project. It imports modules for database operations and renaming fields, then defines an execute function to reload the 'Project' document and rename specific columns if they exist.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to reload the 'Project' document and rename 'from' and 'to' columns to 'from_time' and 'to_time' respectively if they exist.
